backup.intro: Find where to start on CachyOS based on what you did on Windows.
backup.office_note: Check the layout of important documents and test Excel macros before switching.
backup.desktop: File Explorer, ZIP and Snipping Tool → Dolphin, Ark and Spectacle
backup.desktop_note: Search for these tools by name in the KDE application menu.
backup.onedrive: OneDrive → Check where your files are stored
backup.onedrive_note: Download online-only files on Windows before including them in a local backup.
backup.transfer: File transfer → External drive or LocalSend
backup.transfer_note: Use LocalSend to send files over the same network. Open important files after transferring them.
backup.backup_intro: Choose source folders and a separate backup destination. You can use a dedicated folder on an external drive.
backup.missing: Restic is required. You can install it from the Apps tab.
backup.invalid: Choose existing source and destination folders. They must not overlap.
backup.backup_changed: A source or the destination changed after confirmation. Select the folders again.
backup.target_error: The destination must be an empty folder or an existing Restic repository.
backup.bad_password: Enter the password. Both entries must match for a new repository.
backup.new: A new encrypted repository will be created. Keep the password. It is required to access the backup.
backup.existing: A new backup will be added to the existing repository.
backup.partial: Backup incomplete. Some files could not be read. Review the log.
backup.list_ready: Backups listed. Select one and enter your password to restore it.
backup.restore_invalid: Choose an existing empty folder separate from the repository.
backup.restore_plan: All files in the selected backup will be restored to this empty folder.
backup.restore_failed: Restore did not complete. The destination may contain partially restored files.
backup.remember: Remember source folders and backup destination
backup.restore_cancelled: Restore stopped. The destination may contain partially restored files.
